findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure use of temporary files in packaging backend
 * @description Detects use of tempfile functions without secure flags or proper directory control
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/frozenlist/tempfile-misuse
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("packaging/pep517_backend/%") and
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["NamedTemporaryFile", "mkstemp", "mkdtemp", "TemporaryDirectory"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of tempfile function in packaging backend; ensure secure usage (delete flags, permissions, and directories are handled safely)."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure temporary file usage in packaging backend could lead to information disclosure or race conditions

message.text: Use of tempfile function in packaging backend; ensure secure usage (delete flags, permissions, and directories are handled safely).
